audience: teams that produce invoices, contracts and reports as PDF from templates in PDF Generator API

useCases.title: Generate a PDF from a template
useCases.text: Read the data fields the template needs, then generate the document. The vendor keeps the file for 30 days.

useCases.title: Check templates and generated documents
useCases.text: List the templates, read the layout of one template, and list the documents generated from it.

useCases.title: Make a template variant
useCases.text: Copy a template under a new name. The original template is not changed, so edit the copy in the vendor editor.

useCases.title: Convert HTML or a web page to PDF
useCases.text: Render a small HTML string or a public web page to PDF, returned inline as base64. Nothing is stored at the vendor.

useCases.title: Confirm the workspace connection
useCases.text: Read the workspace id, identifier and admin status to confirm that the connection works.
